== Summary ==
Unscaled published-layout comparison for [[Yavin 4: Massassi War Room (V) (Errata 3)]]. First: [[:File:V8-L-yavin4massassiwarroom.gif]]. Second: [[:File:V8-L-yavin4massassiwarroom-Set8-June-2023-partial.png]], losslessly rotated for landscape reading. The official partial omits the artwork window; white is comparison-canvas background, not restored art. No card pixels repainted or sharpened. Official source [[:File:Virtual-Set-8-June-2023.pdf]], page 7, image xref124, original transparency mask123.
